bgl-multi-line.comment: Multi-line #bgl{ ... }, #bglDecl{ ... }, or #bglStmt{ ... } region in .inf files. The bare #bgl form covers both in-routine Beguile islands (§15.6) and file-scope precompiler-mode islands (§15.6b). #bglDecl and #bglStmt are file-scope-only escape hatches in precompiler mode that force declaration-only or statement-only parsing. Indentation back-reference (\1) ensures the closing } matches the opener's indent level, so nested { } inside Beguile statements don't terminate the region prematurely.
bgl-multi-line.name: meta.embedded.block.bgl.inform6

bgl-single-line.comment: Single-line #bgl <statement>; region in .inf files (in-routine, terminated by newline). Captures the rest of the line and re-applies Beguile patterns to it. #bglDecl/#bglStmt have no single-line form.
